verdict.rationale: The evidence only names a first-party 'Web Payments SDK' at the web-payments docs URL, alongside online card, ACH, Afterpay and Cash App payment pages. This suggests an in-page payment SDK, but nothing describes embedding components in the developer's own site or customizing them. missing for 10: documentation that the SDK renders embeddable payment fields or components in the merchant's page, styling or customization options, mobile in-app component support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
